title: Boost for Austin Affordable Housing
summary:
*   **Approval for Affordable Housing:** The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) approved a plan to facilitate the creation of 100 new low-income, single-family rental homes.
*   **Land Deal:** AHFC granted the Anderson Community Development Corporation (ACDC) a six-month option to purchase city-owned land in the SCIP 2 area for this housing project.
*   **Tax Credit Financing:** The initiative will leverage tax credits to ensure the affordability of these rental homes for future residents.
transcript:
MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
April 27, 1995
The meeting was called to order at 5:15 p.m. Present: Bruce Todd, Max Nofziger, Gus
Garcia, Ronney Reynolds, Brigid Shea, Jackie Goodman, Eric Mitchell
Absent:
to
Agenda Item No. 48 (1) Approve a resolution authorizing the General Manager or his
designee to execute a six month option granting the Anderson Community Development
Corporation (ACDC) the right
purchase certain parcels of land
(approximately 34) in the SCIP 2 area currently owned by the Austin Housing Finance
Corporation (AHFC), for the purpose of building 100 low income tax credit financed single
family detached rental homes in the SCIP 2 area (ACDC will acquire the other 66 parcels
needed to complete the 100 units).
Motion
The Board, on Board Member Eric Mitchell's motion and Board Member Ronney Reynolds' second
approved the
Resolution on an unanimous vote.
The meeting was adjourned at 5:17 p.m.
